title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

series.title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

fullText.simplified:
第十四章、宫门出入记录

    在卫宁的帮助下，包拯和公孙策进了宫。包拯对卫宁说，他想去侍卫营，还想向卫宁借个本子看看。
    卫宁笑道：“包大人，你可真奇怪，我有什么本子可以借给你？再说你还有时间到处逛吗？八王爷的案子查得怎么样了？”
    包拯却问：“侍卫营都归你管吧？以前的宫门出入记录本还在侍卫营的库房里吧？”
    “什么？你查案查到我这儿来了？”卫宁吃惊地瞪着包拯。
    “是二十一年前冷宫火灾的事，和你没有关系，那时候你还没来宫里做事。”
    卫宁的眼睛瞪得更大了，但他毕竟是跟在皇帝身边的侍卫总管，什么奇怪的事情没见过？他问：“和八王爷的案子有关？”
    包拯点头。
    “好，你跟我来。”
    皇宫每天的进出情况都有记录。宫里的人什么时候出了宫、什么时候回的宫，宫外的人什么时候进了宫、什么时候出的宫，进进出出是为了什么事，这些都会由值守在宫门口的侍卫详细地记录下来，用来记录的本子就是“宫门出入记录本”了。包拯要查宫门出入记录本，是想知道火灾发生的那几天宫里有没有什么特别的人进出过。
    卫宁把包拯和公孙策带到一个大库房，指着里面堆得像小山一样的箱子说：“这些年的记录全在这儿了，你们自己找吧，我还有事，晚点回来。”
    “非常感谢！”包拯道谢后，马上开始查找起来。
    卫宁是个认真工作的人，库房的管理非常好，箱子是按年份堆放的。包拯没有花多长时间，就在一个箱子里找到了他想要的那一本。
    他把本子拿出来，一页页翻看。
    “十一月一日、二日、三日、四日……五日呢？”包拯愣住了。
    “什么？”公孙策吃惊地把本子拿过去仔细翻看。
    “五日、六日、七日、八日，这四天的记录没有了，被人撕掉了。”包拯很快冷静下来了。
    公孙策看着本子里书页被撕掉的缺口，不敢相信地问：“谁这么大胆子？居然敢撕宫门出入记录本？”
    “应该是谁有这样的能力，可以撕掉宫门出入记录本。”包拯平静地说。
    “这……”公孙策说不下去了，他看向包拯，包拯向他点了点头。这个点头是种肯定，意思是你的猜想和我的猜想是一样的。公孙策的脸有点儿发白，他无力地愣住了。
    包拯也无力地坐到了地上。他失望地看着周围像小山一样的箱子，重重地叹了一口气。
fullText.traditional:
第十四章、宮門出入記錄

    在衛寧的幫助下，包拯和公孫策進了宮。包拯對衛寧說，他想去侍衛營，還想向衛寧借個本子看看。
    衛寧笑道：“包大人，你可真奇怪，我有什麼本子可以借給你？再說你還有時間到處逛嗎？八王爺的案子查得怎麼樣了？”
    包拯卻問：“侍衛營都歸你管吧？以前的宮門出入記錄本還在侍衛營的庫房裡吧？”
    “什麼？你查案查到我這兒來了？”衛寧吃驚地瞪著包拯。
    “是二十一年前冷宮火災的事，和你沒有關係，那時候你還沒來宮裡做事。”
    衛寧的眼睛瞪得更大了，但他畢竟是跟在皇帝身邊的侍衛總管，什麼奇怪的事情沒見過？他問：“和八王爺的案子有關？”
    包拯點頭。
    “好，你跟我來。”
    皇宮每天的進出情況都有記錄。宮裡的人什麼時候出了宮、什麼時候回的宮，宮外的人什麼時候進了宮、什麼時候出的宮，進進出出是為了什麼事，這些都會由值守在宮門口的侍衛詳細地記錄下來，用來記錄的本子就是“宮門出入記錄本”了。包拯要查宮門出入記錄本，是想知道火災發生的那幾天宮裡有沒有什麼特別的人進出過。
    衛寧把包拯和公孫策帶到一個大庫房，指著裡面堆得像小山一樣的箱子說：“這些年的記錄全在這兒了，你們自己找吧，我還有事，晚點回來。”
    “非常感謝！”包拯道謝後，馬上開始查找起來。
    衛寧是個認真工作的人，庫房的管理非常好，箱子是按年份堆放的。包拯沒有花多長時間，就在一個箱子裡找到了他想要的那一本。
    他把本子拿出來，一頁頁翻看。
    “十一月一日、二日、三日、四日……五日呢？”包拯愣住了。
    “什麼？”公孫策吃驚地把本子拿過去仔細翻看。
    “五日、六日、七日、八日，這四天的記錄沒有了，被人撕掉了。”包拯很快冷靜下來了。
    公孫策看著本子裡書頁被撕掉的缺口，不敢相信地問：“誰這麼大膽子？居然敢撕宮門出入記錄本？”
    “應該是誰有這樣的能力，可以撕掉宮門出入記錄本。”包拯平靜地說。
    “這……”公孫策說不下去了，他看向包拯，包拯向他點了點頭。這個點頭是種肯定，意思是你的猜想和我的猜想是一樣的。公孫策的臉有點兒發白，他無力地愣住了。
    包拯也無力地坐到了地上。他失望地看著周圍像小山一樣的箱子，重重地嘆了一口氣。

sentences.traditional: “這……”公孫策說不下去了，他看向包拯，包拯向他點了點頭。
sentences.pinyin: zhè gōng sūn cè shuō bú xià qù le tā kàn xiàng bāo zhěng bāo zhěng xiàng tā diǎn le diǎn tóu
sentences.english: “This …” Gongsun Ce couldn’t continue. He looked at Bao Zheng, who nodded at him.

sentences.simplified: 这个点头是种肯定，意思是你的猜想和我的猜想是一样的。
sentences.traditional: 這個點頭是種肯定，意思是你的猜想和我的猜想是一樣的。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge diǎn tóu shì zhǒng kěn dìng yì si shì nǐ de cāi xiǎng hé wǒ de cāi xiǎng shì yí yàng de
sentences.english: This nod was a kind of affirmation, meaning that your guess is the same as mine.

sentences.simplified: 公孙策的脸有点儿发白，他无力地愣住了。
sentences.traditional: 公孫策的臉有點兒發白，他無力地愣住了。
sentences.pinyin: gōng sūn cè de liǎn yǒu diǎn'r fā bái tā wú lì de lèng zhù le
sentences.english: Gongsun Ce’s face turned a bit pale, and he stood there stunned, feeling powerless.

sentences.simplified: 包拯也无力地坐到了地上。
sentences.traditional: 包拯也無力地坐到了地上。
sentences.pinyin: bāo zhěng yě wú lì de zuò dào le dì shang
sentences.english: Bao Zheng also sat down on the ground, feeling powerless.

sentences.simplified: 他失望地看着周围像小山一样的箱子，重重地叹了一口气。
sentences.traditional: 他失望地看著周圍像小山一樣的箱子，重重地嘆了一口氣。

sentence_translations: Chapter 14: Palace Gate Entry and Exit Records
With Wei Ning’s help, Bao Zheng and Gongsun Ce entered the palace.
Bao Zheng told Wei Ning that he wanted to go to the imperial guard camp, and also wanted to borrow a notebook from Wei Ning to take a look.
Wei Ning laughed and said, “Lord Bao, you are really strange. What kind of notebook do I have that I could lend you?
Moreover, do you even have time to go to all these places? How is the investigation into the Eight Prince’s case going?”
Bao Zheng still asked, “You are in charge of the imperial guard camp, right?
The Palace Gate Entry and Exit Record Book from the past are still in the storeroom at the imperial guard camp, right?”
“What? You’re investigating the case and have come to me?” Wei Ning stared at Bao Zheng in surprise.
“It’s about the fire in the Cold Palace twenty-one years ago. It has nothing to do with you.
You weren’t working in the palace at that time.”
Wei Ning’s eyes widened even more.
But after all, he was the chief imperial bodyguard who worked by the side of the emperor. What strange things hasn’t he seen?
He asked, “Is it related to the case of the Eighth Prince?”
Bao Zheng nodded.
“Okay, follow me.”
The daily comings and goings in the palace are all recorded.
What time the people inside the palace leave and what time they return, ..
.. what time the people outside the palace enter and what time they leave, and the reasons for the comings and goings, ..
.. all of these are meticulously recorded by the guards stationed at the palace gate.
The notebook used for these records is the “Palace Gate Entry and Exit Record Book”.
Bao Zheng wanted to examine the Palace Gate Entry and Exit Record Book ..
.. to find out if any special individuals entered or left the palace during the days when the fire occurred.
Wei Ning took Bao Zheng and Gongsun Ce to a large storeroom.
Pointing to the boxes piled up like small mountains in the room, he said, ..
.. “All the records from these years are here. You can look through them yourselves.
I have other matters to attend to. I’ll come back later.”
“Thank you very much!” Bao Zheng expressed his gratitude and immediately began searching.
Wei Ning was a diligent worker, and the storeroom was very well organized. The boxes were stacked according to the year.
Bao Zheng didn’t take long to find the book he wanted inside a box.
He took the notebook out and flipped through it page by page.
“November 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th … Where’s the 5th?” Bao Zheng was stunned.
“What?” Gongsun Ce took the notebook in shock and carefully looked through it.
“The records for the 5th, 6th, 7th, and 8th, these four days are missing. They’ve been torn out by someone.”
Bao Zheng very quickly calmed down.
Gongsun Ce looked at the torn pages in the notebook and asked in disbelief, “Who would dare to do this?”
Who actually dared to tear out pages from the Palace Gate Entry and Exit Record Book?”
“It must be someone who is able to tear out pages from the Palace Gate Entry and Exit Record Book?” Bao Zheng said calmly.
“This …” Gongsun Ce couldn’t continue. He looked at Bao Zheng, who nodded at him.
This nod was a kind of affirmation, meaning that your guess is the same as mine.
Gongsun Ce’s face turned a bit pale, and he stood there stunned, feeling powerless.
Bao Zheng also sat down on the ground, feeling powerless.
He looked in disappointment at the boxes piled up around him like small mountains and let out a heavy sigh.
